judgments.en_span: Nordlys Énergie SA is an independent producer of renewable electricity with 2,140 MW of installed capacity in Norway, Denmark and Québec.
judgments.zh_span: Nordlys Énergie SA est un producteur indépendant d'électricité renouvelable disposant de 2 140 MW de capacité installée en Norvège, au Danemark et au Québec.
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey identical meaning: company name, status as independent renewable electricity producer, capacity, and geographic locations.

judgments.en_span: The Company is listed on Euronext Paris and the Toronto Stock Exchange.
judgments.zh_span: La Société est cotée sur Euronext Paris et à la Bourse de Toronto.
judgments.explanation: Both passages state the same listing information on Euronext Paris and Toronto Stock Exchange with equivalent meaning.
Both passages provide identical contact information for Investor Relations with the same email address.

judgments.en_span: This press release is published in English and French.
judgments.zh_span: Le présent communiqué est publié en anglais et en français.
judgments.explanation: Both passages state that the press release is published in English and French with equivalent meaning.

judgments.en_span: In the event of any discrepancy between the two versions, the English version shall prevail.
judgments.zh_span: En cas de divergence entre les deux versions, la version anglaise prévaut.
judgments.explanation: Both passages establish that the English version takes precedence in case of discrepancy with equivalent legal meaning.

judgments.en_span: This document contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties; actual results may differ materially.
judgments.zh_span: Ce document contient des déclarations prospectives comportant des risques et des incertitudes ; les résultats réels peuvent différer sensiblement.
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same forward-looking statement disclaimer with equivalent meaning and modality (may/peuvent).
